propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 rejects all verification indices with contract violation when findings list is empty, degrading findings to INDETERMINATE without loss of blocking capability
The root cause is verify_instructions() returning a verification request with no index domain for an empty finding batch, causing the returned indices [0,1,2,...] to be marked unexpected
The zero-finding code path occurs when Pass-1 produces no findings; the empty batch is synthesised as one empty chunk yielding a single verify call that cannot be satisfied truthfully
INDETERMINATE findings cannot trigger BLOCK because pass3_decide(None) short-circuits before blocking checks and partition_findings routes them to advisory only, not to blocking

The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches instead of an imperative to emit verifications, mirroring the contract prerequisite_workflow_ops already states
The blast radius is 43 affected zero-finding runs with spurious ERROR logs and contract violation records, but no blocked or lost findings, as all had correct PASS verdicts
